fact: The Digital Transformation Blueprint 2025-2029 translated the 2025-2026 budget announcements into a roadmap of 84 identified projects in May 2025, an inter-ministerial committee for the Blueprint was created in August 2025, and the ministry submitted its one-year results report on 2025-26 commitments in June 2026.
title: Ministère des Technologies de l'information et de la communication: Une feuille de route respectée, des résultats dans les délais
